'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2021–2022 North Korean missile tests]]
**[[Japan–North Korea relations]]
***[[North Korea]] launches an [[intercontinental ballistic missile]]  towards [[Japan]], prompting evacuation warnings for residents in the prefectures of [[Miyagi Prefecture|Miyagi]], [[Yamagata Prefecture|Yamagata]] and [[Niigata Prefecture|Niigata]]. The missile landed about {{convert|1100|km}} off the Japanese coast in the [[Pacific Ocean]], with the launch likely not successful. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/nov/03/north-korea-launches-ballistic-missile-sparking-emergency-warnings-in-japan (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/north-korea-fires-ballistic-missile-south-koreas-military-2022-11-02/ (Reuters)] [https://www.cnbc.com/2022/11/03/north-korea-icbm-may-have-failed-in-flight-officials-say-residents-in-japan-told-to-shelter.html (CNBC)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**Three [[Palestinians]] are killed during raids by [[Israeli Defense Forces|Israeli soldiers]] in the [[West Bank]], while another is killed in [[East Jerusalem]] after stabbing and injuring a police officer. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/israeli-police-kill-palestinian-west-bank-raid-92586034 (ABC News)]
**A 14-year-old [[Israeli Jews|Jewish]] girl is in [[critical condition]] after being shot in the head by a [[Palestinian]] [[sniper]] in [[Kiryat Arba]], in the occupied [[West Bank]]. [https://www.jewishpress.com/news/eye-on-palestine/palestinian-authority/jewish-girl-14-in-critical-condition-from-arab-snipers-shot-to-her-head-in-kiryat-arba/2022/11/03/ (Jewish Press)]
*[[Attempted assassination of Imran Khan]]
**Former [[Prime Minister of Pakistan|Pakistani Prime Minister]] [[Imran Khan]] is shot in the leg during a rally in [[Wazirabad]], [[Punjab, Pakistan|Punjab]]. Khan is taken to [[Lahore]] for treatment, although he was not seriously injured. A Khan supporter is killed and eight others are injured. The perpetrator is arrested.  [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/11/3/pakistans-ex-pm-imran-khan-injured-by-gunfire-during-long-march (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**Two people are killed and five others are injured when a vehicle carrying students hits a [[roadside bomb]] in [[Mogadishu]], [[Somalia]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/police-explosion-somalias-capital-kills-students-92593713 (ABC News)]
*[[Sistan and Baluchestan insurgency]]
**A [[Shia Islam|Shi'ite]] [[Shia clergy|cleric]] is shot dead at a [[mosque]] in [[Zahedan]], [[Sistan and Baluchestan province]], [[Iran]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iranian-human-rights-lawyers-criticise-clerical-leaders-amid-unrest-2022-11-03/ (Reuters)] 

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2022 inflation surge]]
**[[2018–2022 Turkish currency and debt crisis]]
***[[Inflation]] in [[Turkey]] reaches 85.51%, the highest rate since 1997. [https://www.news24.com/fin24/economy/official-turkish-inflation-rate-jumps-to-85-but-independent-report-shows-it-hit-185-20221103 (AFP via News24)]
**The [[Bank of England]] raises its [[interest rate]]s by 0.75 percentage point, to 3.00%, the largest increase in 33 years, amid soaring inflation and a [[2021–present United Kingdom cost of living crisis|cost of living crisis]] in the UK. The bank also predicts a record-length [[recession]], lasting until mid-2024. [https://www.ft.com/content/7ee4ebdf-ac70-4c9f-84e7-1341ade60bc0 (''The Financial Times'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Five people are killed and four others are injured in a [[methane]] explosion at a [[Coal mining|coal mine]] in [[Karaganda]], [[Kazakhstan]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/11/3/methane-blast-kills-at-least-five-workers-at-kazakhstan-coal-mine (Al Jazeera)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Chagos Archipelago sovereignty dispute]]
**The [[United Kingdom]] agrees to hold negotiations with [[Mauritius]] on the future status of the [[Chagos Archipelago]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/nov/03/uk-agrees-to-negotiate-with-mauritius-over-handover-of-chagos-islands (''The Guardian'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*Australian sex offender [[Peter Scully]] and three of his accomplices are sentenced to 129 years in prison by a [[Regional Trial Court|regional court]] in the [[Philippines]] for 60 offences related to [[child sexual abuse]]. [https://gulfnews.com/world/asia/philippines/australian-sentenced-to-129-years-in-philippine-child-sex-abuse-case-1.91875996 (AFP via ''Gulf News'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2021 Wheelchair Rugby League World Cup]]
**After a year's delay, the [[Wheelchair Rugby League]] [[Wheelchair Rugby League World Cup|World Cup]] begins in [[England]], with Ireland beating Spain 32–55 in the opening game at the [[Copper Box Arena]] in [[London]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2022/nov/03/england-australia-spain-ireland-wheelchair-rugby-league-world-cup (''The Guardian'')]
